title: Goodreads Review Scraper
description: Scrape book reviews from Goodreads. Provide a Goodreads book reviews URL (e.g., https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/2767052-the-catcher-in-the-rye/reviews). Actor paginates through reviews and extracts reviewer information, ratings, dates, and review text.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (alternative)
startUrls.description: Array of Goodreads book review page URLs

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of reviews
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of reviews to collect.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy (residential recommended for Goodreads).
